change: SocRV framework RTL generation and shared memory latency update

incremental_changes.summary: Added one shared configurable response latency for code and data memories.
incremental_changes.consistency: The Verilator SoC top and FPGA memory backends instantiate the same generic memory modules, so both paths use the same defaults.

incremental_changes.summary: Removed global HXI serialization. Instruction and data masters now each own one outstanding slot and may access different slaves concurrently; same-slave conflicts use per-slave round-robin arbitration.
verification: current ISA gate PASS: 40 RV32UI tests

incremental_changes.summary: Added a single-slot retirement event contract for Spike DiffTest, including ordered normal/synchronous-trap events, architectural memory effects, pre-instruction Machine CSR snapshots, and ordered asynchronous interrupt notifications.

Completed the demo core functional DiffTest baseline: RV32M arithmetic, fence.i, precise alignment traps, U/M privilege transitions, Machine CSR legality and WARL behavior, counters, minimal PMP state, and trigger CSR discovery state.
incremental_changes.frequency_note: The demo RV32M multiply/divide implementation is combinational and is a correctness scaffold, not a final FPGA timing implementation.
verification: RV32MI DiffTest PASS: 16/16, including independently validated address-trigger breakpoint traps

incremental_changes.summary: Replaced the demo CPU instance with the imported superscalar core, adapted the core locally to the unchanged SocRV reset vector, memory map, HXI protocol, interrupt inputs and commit-trace contract, and removed the validated demo RTL from the active tree.

assumptions: Each HXI master permits one outstanding transaction; instruction and data requests to different slaves are independent.
Two masters contending for the same HXI slave are serialized by per-slave round-robin arbitration.
Code and data memory are each 64 KiB.
Memory response latency parameters must be at least one cycle.
The superscalar core is the active and final CPU implementation; the demo core has been removed after full regression.
